method.after_packing: 050_uncompressed_detections/<detection config>/detections.jsonl: the same detector on packed canvases (p040, batch size 4), mapped back by p050 (center, else first corner on a group cell; boxes touching no group cell dropped before 050)
method.ap50: all-point interpolated AP at IoU 0.5 over detections above the detector confidence threshold (truncated curve)
method.before_packing: 002_naive/detection.jsonl: the reference pipeline detector on every original frame (batch size 1)
method.counting: TP = detection matched to retained ground truth; detections matched to non-retained ground truth are ignored; unmatched retained detections are FP. Unmatched detections that fail the filter: reference ignored (content Tetris dropped, or boxes crossing the region boundary); packed FP when the box center lies outside every retained tile (p050 mapped it through a corner, the detector drew it over black canvas or a neighbouring polyomino, and Tetris emits it to the tracker; fp_outside_filter), ignored otherwise; packed_ignore_outside ignored (the reference rule on packed detections, a sensitivity variant)
method.detection_configs: variants differing only in tracker share one 030-050 directory and one score set; aggregate over detection_configs, not configs, to count each once

filters.center: box center in a retained tile
filters.center_cover50: box center in a retained tile and >= 50% of its area in retained tiles
filters.frame: every box on the frame (includes region-selection loss)
filters.inside: box entirely inside retained tiles (area cover >= 1 - 1e-9); no counted box is cut at the region boundary

method.frames: per configuration, the frames with at least one retained tile (where it ran detection); frames_sampled counts p020's sampled frames (index % sample_rate == 0, plus each video's last frame)
method.ground_truth: <p110 ground-truth dataset>/execution/<video>/003_groundtruth/tracking.jsonl (the boxes the paper scores HOTA against)
method.item: R1.O4 detection precision/recall before and after packing
method.matching: per frame, greedy by descending confidence, IoU >= 0.5, one to one, all detections against all ground truth; matched_nonretained_with_retained_candidate = 0 means COCO's prefer-non-ignored matching is identical
method.operating_point: fastest Tetris configuration with test HOTA >= reference HOTA x (1 - 0.05)
method.packing_includes: packing as implemented: tile rearrangement, black canvas background, neighbouring polyominoes from other frames, JPEG re-encoding of canvases (cv2.imwrite default quality 95), batch-4 inference, canvas size of whole tiles (Amsterdam 1260 px canvases for 1280 px frames, which also changes the detector letterbox scale)
method.retained_tiles: 033_compressed_frames/<detection config>/{index_maps,offset_lookups}: source tiles on the canvases, padding included
method.sampling: none: every validated test configuration, every test video, every detected frame
method.sweep: median/min/max of each delta over detection configs, per padding mode and overall; padding modes also differ in sample rate, thresholds, and retained region, so differences between modes are associations
